property_summary: For every caller address, the reference contract only allows the address stored in the public depositorAccount variable to invoke setL1BlockValues (i.e. calls succeed iff msg.sender == depositorAccount), whereas the mutant instead allows only the compile-time constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT to call it, breaking the rule when depositorAccount != DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT for some inputs.
change_summary: Keep the require but change the compared identifier from depositorAccount to the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT, altering which address is allowed and thus post-call state.
